purpose: Decompose the frozen Repair39 Akima-versus-PCHIP stage-source representation dependence into the six frozen Repair37 H4 source pieces plus an explicit nonlinear interpolation-coupling residual, with the H4 operator, projected boundary, active mask, output grid and factor-4 Radau propagation fixed.

decomposition_definition.baseline: S_P = PCHIP(total frozen Repair37 primary H4 source)
decomposition_definition.full_alternative: S_A = AKIMA(total frozen Repair37 primary H4 source)
decomposition_definition.exact_identity: S_A - S_P = sum_j delta_j + delta_c at every evaluated x
decomposition_definition.reason_for_coupling: PCHIP and Akima slope construction is nonlinear in nodal data, so interpolating the summed total source need not equal summing separately interpolated pieces.

next_target_rule.if_same_largest_component_in_both_rankin: That component is the primary follow-up target.
next_target_rule.if_different_largest_components: Both largest components are mandatory joint follow-up targets.
next_target_rule.if_INTERPOLATION_COUPLING_is_a_target: The follow-up must test sum-before-interpolation versus interpolation-before-sum representation before direct reconstruction of a physical piece.
next_target_rule.if_only_physical_piece_targets: The follow-up may directly reconstruct those frozen physical source pieces on a finer time grid before any new Z21 science reclosure.

diagnostic_routes.PIECEWISE_STAGE_SOURCE_DECOMPOSITION_COM: All implementation gates pass. Freeze the rankings and the deterministic next target(s); no Z21 certification is allowed.
diagnostic_routes.IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Frozen input binding, baseline/full reproduction, nodal identity, stage-source closure, propagated linear response closure or finiteness fails. Repair40 may be repaired without changing this preregistered contract.
